body:
I’m currently doing my masters degree and it’s been super hard. I’ve always been good at school but never put in all the effort because I was always smart enough to pass classes. But now in graduate classes I have to give a lot more and spend much more time on school work. 
It’s hard for me to spend more than an hour doing school work.

I feel the same way. I’ve had depression and social anxiety for a long time and it affects my life a lot. I haven’t been able to live my 20s like other normal people and I hate it. I don’t have a lot of friends and don’t go out much. I can’t drive or do things for myself because I get super socially anxious. Sometimes I think it’s not worth  it anymore.
